summary: José Manuel Durão Barroso (born 1956) is a politician who led the Social Democratic Party and was prime minister from April 2002 until July 2004, when he left the office on being nominated president of the European Commission. He is in the atlas as the head of government of the coalition formed after the election of 2002.
